name: Neo: Semantic Developer Coordination
description: Eliminate Git merge conflicts by coordinating developers at the semantic layer. Zero conflicts guaranteed in multi-developer AI workflows.
long_description: Neo is a semantic multi-developer coordination engine that prevents merge conflicts BEFORE they reach Git. Instead of detecting conflicts at merge time (after code generation), Neo detects them at the semantic layer during intent declaration, preventing wasted generations entirely and saving 98-99% of tokens in multi-developer workflows.
author: Jay Krishna
features: Semantic conflict detection at intent layer (before code generation)
Automatic lock state machine with queue management (ACQUIRED → WAITING → RELEASED → PROMOTED)
Symbol-level source staleness detection (C1) - instant verification of fresh context
Delta refresh (C2) - 96% token reduction on context updates
Complete activity log audit trail - see who worked on what and when
Zero merge conflicts guaranteed - no manual conflict resolution needed
Works with any agent - Claude, Devin, custom agents
No external dependencies - file-based activity log (just JSON)
Production-ready - sub-millisecond conflict detection, 6,600+ log writes/sec

real_world_examples.title: 5-Developer Authentication Build
real_world_examples.description: Five AI agents building a complete authentication system (OAuth2, JWT, rate limiting, password hashing, session management) on the same file in sequence. Zero merge conflicts despite concurrent intent declarations.

real_world_examples.title: 8-Developer Different Regions
real_world_examples.description: Eight developers working on different regions of the same file. Traditional Git: 10,774 tokens wasted. Neo: 112 tokens. Result: 98.96% savings, zero conflicts.

real_world_examples.title: 8-Developer Same Lines (Worst Case)
real_world_examples.description: Eight developers all modifying the same lines - the hardest scenario for traditional Git. Traditional: 16,090 tokens. Neo: 70 tokens. Result: 99.57% savings, automatic queue coordination.
